answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each identity carry a bonded stake forfeited on proof of duplicate control. A candidate posts a deposit and receives a signing cipher key bound to it; proving two keys share one operator slashes both, so running N fake personas costs N deposits plus detection effort. Reputation acts like pigment that stains every action, and a checkable ladder of public history, a terrace of ranked milestones, lets honest operators stand out without trusting anyone's word.
